- Reads `GET /api/v1/host` through the shared `["host"]` query (same key as `App`, so no second request) with `enabled: !remote`; shows canonical `hostId` + `Revision N`.

Draft state is `null` = "follow canonical", so the field always converges to the authoritative id.
- Error codes mapped like the credential flow (`data-error-code` + `role="alert"` + error-key table): `host.identity_invalid` → localized rejection (draft kept, `aria-invalid`), `host.identity_revision_conflict` → localized message interpolating `{currentRevision}` **and** a canonical re-read (`refetch`) so the retry CASes against the new revision, `permission.denied` → dedicated message, anything else → `hostIdentitySaveFailed`.
- `remote` (Relay) renders no input, no submit and no `role="status"`, and never calls `GET /api/v1/host` — required, since existing App tests assert zero REST on `/settings/hosts/remote-host/general`.
- A11y: real wrapping `<label>` named from `t("hostId")`, hint wired via `aria-describedby`, Enter submits, focus/input stay mounted across success and failure, `role="status"` for saving/saved, status carried by text not colour.

- **Browser/UI verification** of the section (deep link `/settings/hosts/local-host/general`): it needs a build or dev server, both outside the commands you allowed. Per `docs/rules/ui-interaction.md` §10 this still needs a run against the real Host.

If you prefer a `styles.css` rule, that is a follow-up.
- **No Relay/HCP rename path**: `renameHost` is REST-only, because §9.1 of ch.18 makes the entry loopback-only and the remote view must not offer it. The `remote` case shows the id as read-only rather than fetching it over Relay.
